purpose: Connect and implement reusable components used inside applications.

excludedCategories.example-composition: Showcase or example screen; excluded from the app component implementation and connection target.
excludedCategories.documentation: Documentation or library organization asset; excluded from application runtime coverage.
excludedCategories.device-reference: Device, operating-system chrome, example, or original UI-kit reference; use the supported app component rather than duplicating this reference.
excludedCategories.archived: Retired design; excluded from supported app components.

notes: Keep reusable app controls, compositions, internal building blocks, and icons, including the li: Lucide icons.
Retain web, iOS, iPadOS, visionOS, Android, Android XR, and existing macOS app bindings.
Examples and native sample applications may remain as development fixtures; they are not app component coverage targets.
Preserve excluded inventory records for audit. Do not delete design documentation as part of this scope change.
Figma editing remains deferred. Existing out-of-scope source links require cleanup when that work resumes.
